item.title: 40 vehicles involved in multiple accidents that injure more than a dozen on North Jutland Motorway
item.description: Several serious accidents involving approximately 40 vehicles occurred Monday on the E45 North Jutland Motorway. North Jutland Police reported that dense fog and poor visibility likely caused the pile-ups. item.title: Cloudy and foggy conditions across Denmark before rain midweek
item.description: Denmark will see calm but grey weather on Tuesday, with similar conditions across the country before rain returns later in the week. In Copenhagen, the day will remain cloudy with temperatures around 6–7°C. Morning fog will gradually lift by midday, and winds will stay light at around 2–3 m/s. item.title: “When a society asks for your taxes and contribution but denies you a voice, is it truly a democracy?” An international asked Danish members of parliament to allow non-Danes to vote
item.description: After running in the last local election, Simone, 32, wrote to the members of parliament to ask for voting rights for internationals, who are allowed to vote in local elections but not in national ones. Three of them replied, and two said they agree.

item.title: Danish Social Liberals aim to halve pig production
item.description: The Danish Social Liberal Party (De Radikale) has proposed halving Denmark’s pig production within ten years through six welfare demands. Leader Martin Lidegaard states current conditions are significantly worse than in comparable countries. Key requirements include doubling stable space, banning sow fixation, enforcing tail docking bans, and increasing weaning age. The party also seeks to […]
